seo.metaTitle: Contact Us | MEP Engineering Consultation & Proposals | Engivato PLLC
seo.metaDescription: Connect with Engivato PLLC for expert mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering consulting, stamped permit drawings, and fast-track tenant fit-out proposals across Dallas-Fort Worth.

hero.heading: Let's Build Systems That Perform
hero.description: Whether you need full MEP construction documents, a fast-track commercial tenant fit-out, or code compliance review, our team is ready to assist.

formSection.heading: Request an Engineering Proposal
formSection.description: Fill out the details below to discuss your project scope, turnaround timeline, or stamped plan requirements.
formSection.privacyNote: Submissions are transmitted securely and routed to our principal engineering team.
formSection.successMessage: Thank you for reaching out to Engivato PLLC. We have received your inquiry and will review your project requirements within 1 business day.

processSteps.title: Scope & Drawing Review
processSteps.desc: We analyze your architectural backgrounds, existing MEP conditions, and jurisdiction requirements to scope exact deliverables.

processSteps.title: Clear, Itemized Proposal
processSteps.desc: You receive a transparent engineering proposal outlining phases, milestones, permit coordination fees, and completion dates.

processSteps.title: Kick-off & BIM Coordination
processSteps.desc: Upon authorization, our engineering team initiates load calculations, equipment sizing, and clash-free 3D Revit modeling.

sidebar.plansBoxDescription: If you have CAD files, Revit models, or PDF architectural drawings, you can email them directly or include a cloud link in your message.

faqs.question: How fast is proposal turnaround?
faqs.answer: Standard proposals are delivered within 24 to 48 business hours after receiving your scope details and architectural backgrounds.

faqs.question: Do you handle fast-track deadlines?
faqs.answer: Yes. We routinely coordinate expedited tenant improvement and renovation sets for retail, restaurant, and commercial spaces.

faqs.question: Are all drawings stamped by a licensed P.E.?
faqs.answer: Yes. All final construction documents are sealed by licensed Professional Engineers conforming to Texas municipal building codes.
